mentions.name: KEIBIDROP
mentions.description: Tool that makes remote files appear as local, hiding network latency so users can open and edit a peer's file without downloading it upfront or re-uploading it fully. The next version (0.4.0) plans multi-user support, switching the networking layer from TCP to UDP (QUIC), optimization of live-edit regions of files, and further testing for data-heavy workflows.
mentions.problem: Opening and editing files stored on a remote peer normally requires downloading them upfront and re-uploading changes due to network latency.
mentions.source_excerpt: KEIBIDROP: Makes remote files appear as local (it hides the network latency in order to let you open and edit a peers file without downloading it upfront or re-uploading it fully back).
